name: Creative writing
description: Reading aids for a manuscript: give a chapter file or a folder of .md/.txt chapters. Statistics gives length, sentences, dialogue share, adverbs and the English reading level per chapter, with the very long sentences; Repeated phrases finds tics (four-word phrases used three times or more, a word echoed within six words) with their lines; Names counts the names and flags ones spelled almost the same. They point at places to look; the writer and the agent decide. Nothing is changed or run. Word documents: pandoc or the Document formats tool.

presets.label: Statistics (length, sentences, dialogue, reading level)
presets.description: Words, sentences, paragraphs, dialogue share, -ly adverbs and the English reading level, per chapter when you give a folder of .md/.txt files; lists the very long sentences with their line.

presets.label: Repeated phrases and echoes
presets.description: Phrases of four words used three or more times and a word used again within six words, each with its file and line. Some are on purpose; look at each.

presets.label: Names and spelling slips
presets.description: Counts the capitalised names (not sentence starts) and lists the ones spelled almost the same, such as Catherine and Katherine, which are often a slip in a long manuscript.
